added.summary: A data-hold element draws a fill from its start edge across the share of the hold its press has reached, over its background and under its content; button::-og-hold { background } colours it (::-og-hold is a pseudo-element box, as ::backdrop is). Enter, Space or a pad's A held while it has the focus hold it, and so does its data-action's input.

added.member: UI document <input type=checkbox switch data-on data-off>
added.summary: A switch's on and off words are its value for a screen reader and the probe.

With -og-stepper: buttons, -og-stepper-wrap: wrap goes past max to min, -og-stepper-large-step sets what a held button's repeats move by, and data-format writes the value through an ICU message over value in the UI's locale ({value, number} m, {value, number, compact}, {value, plural, =0 {Off} other {#}}), checked when the document is parsed.
A search box draws HTML's clear button at its end while it has text (`<id>/Clear`, dressed `<component>.clear`); a press empties it.
-og-select-filter: on puts a filter field atop the open list, off keeps it away, auto (the default) shows it past 10 options; data-filter-placeholder is what it shows while empty.

added.member: UI document <tabs icons badges>, tabPrev and tabNext
added.summary: icons and badges (a list each, one per tab) draw an icon before a tab's label and a count badge after it. The tabPrev and tabNext actions (Q and E, LB and RB) step through a document's tabs, wrapping.
HTML's exclusive accordion: of the disclosures in a mount sharing a literal name, one is open at once; opening one closes the others the next tick and writes their open state back.

`og ui eject hold-button` (a hold-to-confirm button with its holding words and hint) and `og ui eject action-hints` (the action bar: a <kbd data-action> glyph and hint per action, a hold row filling as its action is held).

breaking.fix: Write `<button data-hold="1200" onhold={confirm}>Delete save</button>` in a document (its fill is `button::-og-hold { background: … }`) and read the hold from og.ui.docEvents, or eject the `hold-button` component document.

breaking.change: The action bar builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write a row of `<button onclick={press}><kbd data-action={h.action}></kbd> {h.hint}</button>` over og.ui.actionBar's hints (a hold one with `data-hold` and `data-action`, so the action's hold fills it), or eject the `action-hints` component document. Place it with CSS (`position: absolute; inset-block-end: 0`): a screen's root already keeps out of the safe area.
Write `<label><input type="checkbox" switch data-on="On" data-off="Off" bind:checked={$music}> Music</label>` in a document; the caption's side is its source order in the label.

breaking.change: The number stepper builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<input type="number" min="1" max="8" data-format="{value, number} players" bind:value={$players}>` with `-og-stepper: buttons` (and `-og-stepper-wrap: wrap`, `-og-stepper-large-step: 10`) in its `<style>`.

breaking.change: The framed text field builders are removed.
breaking.fix: Write the field as markup: `<label for>` above, a row of `<icon>`, `<input class="bare" maxlength="20" bind:value={$name}>` (`appearance: none`, the row styled with `:focus-within`) and a `<span>` suffix, then `<small>{$name.length}/20</small>` for the count and a `<small role="alert">` for the error; `<input type="search">` draws the clear button; `<textarea rows>` for several lines.

breaking.change: The bare text input builders are removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<input bind:value={$name}>` or `<textarea rows="4" bind:value={$note}>` in a document (`type`, `inputmode`, `autocomplete`, `maxlength`, `placeholder`, `readonly` as in HTML).

Write `<select bind:value={$lang}>` with `<option>`s (under `<optgroup>`s) in a document; `-og-select-filter: on` and `data-filter-placeholder` give its open list a filter, `select::picker(select) { max-height }` bounds it.

breaking.change: The tab bar builder is removed.
breaking.fix: Write `<tabs items="Gear Quests" icons="sword shield" badges={$unread} bind:selected={$tab}>` in a document with the selected tab's panel under it in an `{#if}`; tabPrev and tabNext step it, and `<kbd data-action="tabPrev">` shows a bumper's glyph.
Write a `<details name="faq" summary="Rules">` per section in a document; one name keeps one open at once (single), no name lets several open.

breaking.change: The screen helpers no longer export the removed builders.
breaking.fix: Build those controls in the kit's screen document: `<input>`, `<select>`, `<button data-hold>`.

breaking.change: name on a <details> is its exclusive accordion group, no longer its accessible name.
breaking.fix: Name a disclosure for a screen reader with aria-label; keep name for the group.
